text_001.zh: 面向先进集成的热通路

text_002.en: Building efficient thermal pathways for advanced integrated circuits
text_002.zh: 为先进集成电路构建高效热通路

text_003.en: We investigate how heat is generated and transported across materials, interfaces, devices, interconnects, and package structures in high-performance chips, heterogeneous integration, and advanced packaging. We develop high-thermal-conductivity materials, interface engineering, advanced thermal characterization, and thermal-management technologies for three-dimensional integration.
text_003.zh: 我们面向高性能芯片、异质集成与先进封装，研究热量在材料、界面、器件、互连和封装结构中的产生与传递，并发展高导热材料、界面调控、先进热表征和三维集成热管理技术。

text_008.en: Thermal management is becoming a core constraint on IC integration
text_008.zh: 热管理正在成为大规模芯片集成技术的核心约束

text_009.en: As chips move toward higher power density and greater integration, thermal challenges shift from external cooling into the chip structure. Local hotspots, inter-layer thermal coupling, interface resistance, and constrained vertical pathways jointly affect performance, reliability, and integration architecture.
text_009.zh: 随着芯片向更高功率密度和更高集成度发展，热问题已经从外部散热进入芯片结构内部。局部热点、层间热耦合、界面热阻和受限的垂直热通路，共同影响芯片的性能、可靠性与集成方式。

text_010.en: In 2.5D and 3D systems, materials, interconnect structures, bonding processes, and package architectures together determine total thermal resistance. Thermal management has therefore become an integral part of advanced integration technology.
text_010.zh: 在2.5D与3D集成系统中，材料选择、互连结构、键合工艺和封装架构同时决定最终热阻。热管理因此成为先进集成技术的重要组成部分。

text_011.en: Lower thermal resistance supports more usable power and computing performance.
text_011.zh: 更低的热阻，支持更高的可用功率与计算性能。

text_012.en: Research system from materials to 3D integration
text_012.zh: 从材料到3D集成的研究体系

text_018.en: Growth, thermal transport, and size effects in high-thermal-conductivity semiconductors and heat-spreading materials, including diamond, AlN, SiC, and related materials.
text_018.zh: 研究高导热半导体与热扩散材料的生长、热输运和尺寸效应，关注金刚石、AlN、SiC及相关材料在芯片热管理中的应用。

text_020.en: Heat transfer across heterogeneous interfaces, buried interfaces, and bonding layers, with emphasis on how interfacial structure and processing determine thermal resistance.
text_020.zh: 研究异质材料界面、埋层界面和键合层中的热传递，揭示界面结构与制备工艺对热阻的影响。

text_022.en: Local hotspots in micro- and nanoelectronic devices, effective thermal conductivity of BEOL and advanced interconnects, and heat-spreading paths in complex device structures.
text_022.zh: 研究微纳电子器件中的局部热点、BEOL与先进互连的有效热导率，以及复杂器件结构中的热扩散路径。

text_024.en: Co-design of heat-spreading layers, high-conductivity pathways, and package structures for chiplet integration, 3D stacking, and advanced packaging.
text_024.zh: 面向芯粒集成、三维堆叠和先进封装，探索热扩散层、高导热通路与封装结构协同设计，提升集成系统的散热能力与可靠性。

text_027.en: TDTR, FDTR, SSTR, and thermal imaging in real process structures
text_027.zh: TDTR、FDTR、SSTR及热成像，获得真实工艺结构热参数

text_029.en: Heat-transfer models, sensitivity analysis, atomic-scale characterization, and uncertainty
text_029.zh: 传热模型、敏感度分析、原子级表征与不确定性评估

text_031.en: High-conductivity materials, interface engineering, heat spreaders, and local pathways
text_031.zh: 高导热材料、界面工程、热扩散层与局部热通路设计

text_033.en: Heterogeneous integration, 3D stacking, and advanced packaging
text_033.zh: 将材料与界面研究转化到异质集成、三维堆叠与先进封装

text_035.en: Experimental verification feeds the next design cycle
text_035.zh: 通过实验验证热管理效果，进入下一轮优化

text_037.en: A 3D-IC places chiplets, interconnects, and bonding interfaces within a confined volume. Every layer and interface can limit the thermal pathway.
text_037.zh: 3D-IC将多个芯粒、互连和键合界面集成在有限空间内。每一层材料和每一个界面都可能成为热通路中的限制因素。

text_045.en: Move through the questions to trace thermal bottlenecks across the stack.
text_045.zh: 浏览右侧问题，逐层查看3D-IC中的热瓶颈。

text_047.en: Can high-thermal-conductivity films retain their material advantage at device-relevant thicknesses, and how do grain boundaries, dimensions, and defects change thermal conductivity?
text_047.zh: 高导热薄膜能否在实际厚度下保持材料优势？晶界、尺寸和缺陷如何影响薄膜热导率？

text_049.en: How do local hotspots and thermal coupling between chiplets affect performance and reliability?
text_049.zh: 局部热点和不同芯粒之间的热耦合如何影响性能与可靠性？

text_050.en: How do advanced interconnects and low-k dielectrics change the effective vertical thermal pathway?
text_050.zh: 先进互连和低介电常数材料如何改变垂直热通路与有效热导率？

text_052.en: Does the bonding interface become a dominant thermal resistance in the stack?
text_052.zh: 混合键合界面是否构成热通路中的主要热阻？

text_054.en: How can heat-spreading layers and high-conductivity pathways be embedded in 3D-ICs to improve system-level heat dissipation?
text_054.zh: 热扩散层和高导热通路如何嵌入3D-IC，并提升跨层热通路与系统散热能力？

text_056.en: Advanced thermal characterization is a core research capability for developing thermal-management and integration technologies. The platform combines optical thermal metrology, thermal imaging, customized model fitting, and automated data processing to study and validate materials, devices, interconnects, and packages.
text_056.zh: 先进热表征是实验室发展热管理与集成技术的核心研究能力。平台集成多种光学热测量系统、热成像技术、定制化模型拟合与自动化数据处理，支持材料、器件、互连和封装结构的研究与验证。

text_057.zh: 套热测量系统及相关流程

text_058.zh: 薄膜、界面与器件相关尺度

text_062.zh: 参数提取与不确定性分析

text_063.en: Connecting thermal science with integrated-circuit technology
text_063.zh: 连接热科学与集成电路技术

text_064.en: We develop a complete research chain spanning heat-transport mechanisms, advanced characterization, materials and interface control, heterogeneous integration, and advanced-packaging applications to deliver verifiable thermal-management technologies for high-performance integrated circuits.
text_064.zh: 我们致力于建立从热输运机理、先进表征和材料界面调控，到异质集成与先进封装应用的完整研究链路，为高性能集成电路提供可验证的热管理技术。

image_01.alt_zh: 多层三维集成电路剖面图，展示芯粒、互连、混合键合、局部热点与垂直热流通路

image_02.alt_zh: 先进热表征实验室全景，展示光学测量、显微测试、热成像与自动化测量系统
